company.name: Untap
company.shortDescription: A competition management platform that enables innovation-driven organizations to plan, launch, manage, and assess open innovation programs.
company.description: Untap is a competition management platform used by organizations to easily plan, launch, manage, and assess online competitions. It streamlines the entire process of receiving and managing submissions, engaging with applicants and judges, evaluating entries, running multiple rounds of submissions, and generating an in-depth analysis. Untap enables companies, grant providers, universities, educational institutions, and accelerators to tap into the power of open innovation.
